::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What FOIL means

To multiply $(a + b)(c + d)$, multiply each term of the first bracket by each term of the second:

| Letter | Step | In $(a + b)(c + d)$ |
|:------:|:-----|:--------------------|
| **F** | **First** terms | $a \cdot c$ |
| **O** | **Outer** terms | $a \cdot d$ |
| **I** | **Inner** terms | $b \cdot c$ |
| **L** | **Last** terms | $b \cdot d$ |

Then add the four products and combine like terms: $(a + b)(c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd$.
:::
